statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, glowing particle field with retro aesthetics that responds to user interaction. The particles move autonomously in a chaotic pattern, forming temporary geometric connections as they approach each other. When the user drags their cursor across the canvas, it triggers a scattering effect—particles burst outward along the cursor's path and form intricate lattices before fading back into the background. The visual experience combines organic motion with structured patterns, creating an immersive, interactive environment where the viewer can influence the chaotic system through direct manipulation.
